content.title: Texas vs. Gonzaga: Predictions, How to Watch for Free (3/21/26)
content.text: No. 11 Texas (20–14) faces No. 3 Gonzaga (31–3) today in the 2026 NCAA Tournament Second Round at the Moda Center in Portland. Texas comes in off a 79–71 first-round win over No. 6 BYU on Thursday, powered by big man Matas Vokietaitis. The seven-foot sophomore from Lithuania scored 23 points on 10-of-17 shooting and grabbed 16 boards for a double-double. Tramon Mark, the hero of the Longhorns’ First Four win over NC State, followed with 19 points, knocking down three 3-pointers. And Dailyn Swain added 14 points. Texas had no answer for BYU’s AJ Dybantsa, who finished with 35 points. But his dominance, as the Cougars have seen since the final stretch of the regular season, hasn’t automatically translated into wins, given BYU’s issues with depth. BYU’s four-man bench went scoreless, making just one field-goal attempt. Gonzaga, meanwhile, had a much easier first-round matchup, defeating No. 14 Kennesaw State, 73–64. Graham Ike led the Bulldogs as he’s done all season, with 19 points. Davis Fogle added 19 off the bench. Gonzaga shot just 40% from the field but held the Owls to just 36% from the floor. Prediction Gonzaga was tested with an early-season schedule stacked with top-25 matchups, prevailing in four of them, but enters after a light conference and early tournament schedule. Expect this one to be tight with the Bulldogs prevailing — barely — over a Texas team that has survived the grind of an SEC schedule. Predicted Final Score: Gonzaga 76, Texas 74 Tip-off for today’s game between Texas and Gonzaga is set for 7:10 PM Eastern / 6:10 PM Central / 4:10 PM Pacific at the Moda Center in Portland. The game airs on TBS and streams live on the TBS app and website, as well as HBO Max. If you’re a cord-cutter without an active livestreaming plan, you can watch the game for free by taking advantage of free trials from DIRECTV STREAM, Hulu + Live TV, or YouTube TV. Hulu + Live TV also includes Disney+ and ESPN Select as part of its standard plan.
